villa.title: Facade
villa.description: A teak-clad first floor cantilevers over a white ground floor with floor-to-ceiling black-steel glazing. The deep overhang keeps the afternoon sun off the glass.

villa.title: Entrance & jali
villa.description: A pivot teak door under a slim canopy, an Athangudi-tile porch and a pierced jali screen that lets the breeze through while keeping the dining room private.

villa.title: Living room
villa.description: An open living room with a navy sofa, mustard chairs and a marble coffee table, glazed on two sides. A small teak console holds the evening lamp.

villa.title: Kitchen & dining
villa.description: An island kitchen with a black granite worktop and brass stools, opening onto a six-seat dining table by the garden window.

villa.title: Master bedroom
villa.description: The upstairs master suite has a teak-clad window wall, a walk-along wardrobe and a reading corner. Lift the roof with the layers button to see every room from above.

villa.title: Pool deck
villa.description: A narrow lap pool framed by travertine coping, two loungers and coconut palms. The garden wall keeps the street out.

villa.title: Flat roof
villa.description: A flat concrete roof with a deep fascia, a rooftop water tank and a solar array for the pumps and lights.

flat.title: Living room
flat.description: A teak-panelled TV wall, a navy three-seater and two mustard chairs around a marble coffee table. The oak floor runs straight into the dining area.

flat.title: Dining
flat.description: A four-seat oak table under a linear pendant, with a walnut sideboard and a window onto the back lane.

flat.title: Kitchen
flat.description: A galley kitchen with a black granite counter, a pass-through to the dining room and a shelf of brass vessels.

flat.title: Pooja unit
flat.description: A teak pooja cabinet with a granite ledge, a red back panel and a small kuthuvilakku, placed just inside the entrance as in many Chennai flats.

flat.title: Master bedroom
flat.description: A sage-green headboard wall, a walnut wardrobe and an attached bathroom with a glass shower.

flat.title: Second bedroom & study
flat.description: A single bed, a compact wardrobe and a desk by the window, so the second room can double as a work-from-home study.

office.title: Reception
office.description: A travertine reception desk in front of a slatted teak feature wall with a brass logo plate, and a navy waiting sofa.

office.title: Open workspace
office.description: Four benches of four desks, each with a sage divider and a monitor. Polished concrete underfoot keeps the floor cool and easy to clean.

office.title: Meeting room
office.description: A glass-walled room for eight around a walnut table, with a wall screen for presentations and a linear pendant above.

office.title: Lounge & oonjal
office.description: Rust sofas, mustard chairs and a library wall, plus a teak oonjal for the five-minute break that makes the afternoon work.

office.title: Pantry
office.description: A long oak pantry run with a black granite top and an island with three leather stools, close to the window wall.
